consumers.usage: Its backend discovers the contract bundle at startup and validates each document against the schema matching its declared version; packages/quake-geometry promotes legacy documents to current at its decode door and runs the current conformance vectors.
Discovers the contract bundle at startup — the one current schema plus every deprecated one — to derive the version it writes and the versions it can read back.
Discovers the contract bundle at startup and admits its CURRENT version only; rooms are a live protocol, not documents at rest.
Discovers the contract bundle at startup; it reads every readable version and its APMap producer declares the current one, derived from the layout.

Stages this package's schema/ directory as the APMap contract bundle: writes APMAP_SCHEMA_DIR into each component's .env for native runs, and packages the same directory into every APMap-aware Docker image as the apmap-contract build context, with a provenance manifest of the AULIBS commit and each schema sha256. It reads the layout and never a version.
